purpose: Pre-release regression review after platform split and OS-specific shortcuts
result: Release held: hidden source and final installer suites passed, but test-owned Bash/OpenConsole descendants survived Electron shutdown; native cleanup and remaining release checks are unresolved
sourceFingerprintNote: Captured before adding the long-term verification documents; application and test corrections are identified below.
changesReviewed: Platform terminal/clipboard/desktop/activity adapters and common session lifetime
Terminal link validation and browser handoff
OS-specific shortcut defaults, migration, persistence, menu routing and file actions
Settings scrolling and reusable hidden E2E lifecycle

fixes.problem: On Windows, Chromium reopened file context menus through Shift+F10 and ContextMenu after those bindings were changed or cleared.
fixes.resolution: Cancel Chromium default keydown and dedicated menu-key keyup behavior while preserving configured shortcuts and mouse right-click.

fixes.problem: Shortcut input capture counted Windows ConPTY focus responses as user input.
fixes.resolution: Forward only the existing known device/focus protocol replies to the real shell; continue asserting all shortcut input bytes and clipboard counts.

lockedDependencies.reason: Only the identified renderer/test files changed after npm ci; dependency, lockfile, native patch and build configuration inputs stayed unchanged.

package.installerScope: Directory chooser first; scope radio buttons removed; /allusers rejected with exit 2

nativePayload.dllAndOpenConsole: Both runtime loader paths match the prepared source binaries

nativeCleanup.manualCleanup: Six verified test-owned processes were stopped; no remaining processes at their test executable paths
nativeCleanup.limitation: Current GUI closeCleanly checks Electron exit and window interference, not the complete descendant tree. Do not treat the passing suites as proof that child process lifetime is fixed.

checks.guiPolicy: Same 69 hidden case identities; all required cases executed, retries and flaky results zero
checks.architectureReview: No cross-OS adapter imports or renderer/preload/shared imports of main platform implementations; common ACK, generation, async clipboard rechecks and shutdown ownership retained

macEvidence.limitation: Historical Mac results are not new runs or final-package verification; this turn also changes FilesView.
